recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, moody portrait of a man in profile wearing a wide-brimmed felt hat and leather jacket, featuring high-contrast lighting that emphasizes texture and form, paired with a mix of elegant serif and raw brushed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the hat brim creates a leading line toward the subject's face.
The warm tan of the hat contrasts against the cool, dark teal-grey background.
The rough, hand-drawn texture of the top text balances the clean, formal serif at the bottom.
coreInvariants: Wide-brimmed fedora with a ribbon band
Black leather motorcycle jacket with visible hardware
Deep shadows with soft edge transitions

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tan hat acts as the primary visual anchor due to its color and scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the hat, follows the brim down to the face, then moves to the large serif text at the bottom, finally circling back to the brushed text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space in the upper right and lower left, utilized for typographic placement.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white text and dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and cool darks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Transitional Serif and Expressive Brush Script
letterConstructionRules: Primary display text uses high-contrast serifs with wide tracking.
Secondary display text uses aggressive, dry-brush strokes with varying baseline heights.
Body/Metadata text uses small-caps with extreme letter spacing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: J-descender in primary text is elongated and curved
Brushed letters have visible bristle textures and jagged edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between formal, static serif and energetic, organic brush lettering.

preserve: Wide tracking in the serif text
Angled placement of the brush text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast serif elegance for the main title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Dry Brush or Street Art Script
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, energetic feel of the secondary name text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic, low-key portrait of a man in profile looking down, wearing a tan wide-brimmed fedora and a black leather jacket. Lighting should be dramatic with deep shadows and a cool-toned dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, wide-tracked serif title in the lower third. Add a smaller, white, hand-brushed script name in the upper right corner, tilted slightly. Include a small-caps subtitle at the very bottom with extreme tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the hat the brightest non-text element?
Is the serif text tracking wide enough to span the width of the subject?
Does the brush text have a visible dry-ink texture?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between white text and dark background.
Ensure the leather jacket texture is visible in the midtones.
Verify the hat brim creates a strong diagonal composition.
Confirm the serif font feels classic and the brush font feels modern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + Tan Fedora + Leather Jacket + (Wide-Track Serif / Angled Brush Script) = Modern Country Aesthetic
